headline: Apple posts an Analog Mixed-Signal Modeling Software role
fact: Apple posted an Analog Mixed-Signal Modeling Software Engineer role whose description covers multi-simulator platforms, scientific-software and automation frameworks, custom model libraries, simulation frameworks, domain-specific languages, and web interfaces for AMS circuit design.

sources.title: Analog Mixed-Signal Modeling Software Engineer (m/f/d)
sources.summary: Official Apple role dated April 14, 2026, for AMS modeling tools, multi-simulator platforms, model libraries, frameworks, domain-specific languages, and designer-facing interfaces.
